newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Chidambaram among 6 to join government - PTI.
newsitem.headline: India's Chidambaram among 6 to join government - PTI.

text.p: Former finance minister P. Chidambaram was expected to return to his post on Wednesday in the new government of Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.

The news agency said Chidambaram, three other members of his regional Tamil Maanila Congress (TMC) party, Janata Dal party leader Jaipal Reddy and Maqbool Dar were expected to be inducted into Gujral's council of ministers on Wednesday evening.
President Shankar Dayal Sharma has scheduled a swearing in ceremony for 7:30 p.m. (1400 GMT) on Wednesday, his office said.
TMC leader G.K. Moopanar announced late on Tuesday in the southern city of Madras that the regional party would enter Gujral's government.
The party had tentatively decided on April 19 to stay out of the new government after the ruling United Front passed over Moopanar in its leadership choice.

TMC leaders, who in general were strongly opposed to entering Gujral's cabinet, had left the final decision on whether to join the government to Moopanar, who said it was in the national interest for the party to take ministerial portfolios.
Chidambaram was expected to be renamed finance minister, a post which Gujral has held for himself since assuming power on April 21 in hopes that the economic strategist would return to government.

Three other TMC leaders were expected to rejoin the government. M. Arunachalam would return to become labour minister, while S. R. Balasubramaniam would be junior personnel minister and Dhanushkodi Athithan junior human resource development minister.
Newspapers said Jaipal Reddy, the longtime spokesman for Gujral's Janata Dal party, was expected to become information and broadcasting minister, replacing C.M. Ibrahim.
Ibrahim, a close confidant of former prime minister H.D. Deve Gowda, is also in charge of civil aviation.
Maqbool Dar could not take the oath of office on April 21 when the rest of Gujral's team was sworn in, and will become junior home (interior) minister, PTI said.
